query:
SELECT k.user_id as "user_id!: SbUserId", k.id as "id!",
                    EXISTS (
                        SELECT 1 FROM collection_saves s
                        WHERE s.user_id = k.user_id AND s.collection_id = k.id
                    ) as "saved!"
                FROM unnest($1::int[], $2::uuid[]) AS k(user_id, id)
